Name: Farm Goals - Seasonal Challenges
Author: littlelodgegames
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Make everyday farming count toward something bigger.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Farm Goals adds two complementary ways to progress: permanent milestones for your long-term achievements, and seasonal challenges that give each season its own set of objectives.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Work toward milestones through farming, fishing, mining, crafting, friendships, and other activities. Each milestone has multiple reward tiers, so your progress continues beyond the first achievement.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Seasonal challenges provide shorter goals with individual rewards. By default, four are selected each season. Their targets consider your farm’s progression, and installing partway through a season reduces the targets to account for the time remaining.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Open the Farm Goals menu to see your progress, rewards, and remaining time. Expand milestone headings to inspect their reward tiers. [/color][color=#d4d4d8]Complete every seasonal challenge to earn an additional completion bonus.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract the mod archive.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]FarmGoals[/code]folder inside your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Load your save and read the introduction and seasonal challenge letters.[/*]
[/list]Open Farm Goals with [b]F9[/b] or the [b]bullseye tab on the left of the game menu[/b].

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]16 permanent milestone categories[/b] covering:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Harvesting crops and catching fish.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Shipping artisan goods and earning gold.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Breaking rocks, cooking, and crafting.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Raising animals and collecting animal products.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Building friendships and giving loved gifts.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Completing quests.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Museum donations and discovering artifacts.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Restoring Community Center rooms, including equivalent Joja progression.[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]51 milestone tiers[/b] across the default milestone set.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]15 seasonal challenge types[/b], with four challenges per season by default.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Progression-aware selection:[/b] Certain challenges become available only once the farm has reached the relevant activities.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Scaling targets:[/b] Many seasonal targets grow with the farm’s year.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Mid-season adjustment:[/b] New challenges account for the days remaining when installed.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Varied rewards:[/b] Gold, Prize Tickets, useful items, friendship increases, and Qi Gems when eligible.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Completion bonus:[/b] Finish all seasonal challenges for an extra gold reward.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Clear progress menus:[/b] This Season and Milestones pages with progress bars and expandable details.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Introduction and seasonal letters:[/b] Learn the system and receive each season’s challenge list.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Configurable difficulty and rewards:[/b] Adjust challenge counts, target difficulty, reward types, gold amounts, and more.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/url], using a release compatible with your game.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Works with new and existing saves.[/*]
[*]Previously reached milestone tiers are recognised without paying their rewards again by default. Enable
[code]PayMilestonesReachedBeforeInstall[/code]if you want those rewards.[/*]
[*]Historical crop-harvest progress starts from the game’s recorded crops shipped. Harvests are counted directly after installation.[/*]
[*]Challenge selection is consistent for each save and season; reloading does not reroll the challenges.[/*]
[*]Rewards are granted automatically when completed goals are checked.[/*]
[*][b]Prize Tickets are redeemed at the Prize Machine inside Mayor Lewis’s house.[/b][/*]
[*]Friendship rewards affect villagers your farmer already knows.[/*]
[*]Qi Gem rewards are available only after the relevant progression is unlocked.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer support is [b]host-only[/b].[/*]
[*]Progress and rewards follow the game’s saving behaviour. Quitting without saving rolls back that day.[/*]
[*]Edit
[code]config.json[/code]after the first launch. Challenge-setting changes apply when the next season’s challenges are generated.[/*]
[/list]
